verdict.rationale: Superset provides a built-in diff viewer where developers review exactly what an agent changed (Changes tab, select/comment on diff lines) before staging, committing, and creating a PR, giving an explicit review-then-approve-then-PR workflow. Missing for 10: no explicit 'approval gate' or blocking mechanism preventing PR creation without review, and no independent hands-on account confirming the review-before-PR step in practice.
